notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only the bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Clause 9.13 Request Attribute Value Update With Regions form in Umbra's non-installable embedded development profile. It validates region-set pair parsing, empty-pair no-op behavior, overlap-consistent provider solicitation, default-region eligibility, committed region context, callback-entry rechecks, and explicit provider responses: the provider invokes no-time Update Attribute Values or a timestamped Update Attribute Values from the official callback and an overlap-qualified requester receives the response tag, producer, transportation, timestamp/order metadata, and explicit sent update region. Focused filesystem cases additionally prove the accepted requester appends its private §9.13 type-36/type-4/type-63 successful-void record before any eligible provider callback and that the provider callback appends its separate private §6.22 type-37/type-1/type-63 record before callback user code; region handles remain the eligibility filter rather than new §6.22 supplied arguments. A companion changes the requester's committed subscription to a disjoint range before callback dispatch and suppresses the stale reflection. Automatic provision, broader timestamped/retraction matrices, advisory scope transitions, relaxed DDM, save/restore, remote transport, package support, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
